title: cotoneaster linearifolius
intro: Cotoneaster linearifolius, commonly known as Chinese cotoneaster, is a type of flowering plant in the rose family (Rosaceae). It is used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate digestive issues and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Cotoneaster linearifolius include analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects, which may help to soothe pain and reduce swelling. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
